info.title: SLSEA Solar Generation Data API
info.description: Real-time solar generation data service. JWT bearer authentication: operators authenticate at /api/auth/operator/login, solar devices at /api/auth/device/login. Operators are scoped to their geographic jurisdiction (national, provincial or district); devices may only append readings for their own installation.
